# repo-aeo

> Audit and improve repository discoverability: GitHub metadata and topics, README structure, AGENTS.md, the npm publish surface, llms.txt and structured data.

Zero runtime dependencies, Node >= 18, read-only by default. Part of the Repo
Discoverability Kit (RDK) monorepo: https://github.com/WhiteBite/repo-aeo

## Docs

- [README.md](./README.md): install, commands, output formats, safety model.
- [Repository README](https://github.com/WhiteBite/repo-aeo#readme): the product, the three layers and the score model.
- [docs/scoring.md](https://github.com/WhiteBite/repo-aeo/blob/main/docs/scoring.md): how the 0–100 Discoverability Score is computed.
- [docs/configuration.md](https://github.com/WhiteBite/repo-aeo/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): `.discoverability/project.yml` reference.
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/WhiteBite/repo-aeo/tree/main/skills/repo-discoverability): SKILL.md for Codex/Cursor/OpenCode/Claude Code.

## Key facts

- Install: `npm install --save-dev repo-aeo`
- Run: `npx repo-aeo audit`
- Test: `npm test`
- Commands: `init`, `audit`, `fix`, `npm-surface`, `github-sync`.
- Programmatic API: `import { audit, planPatches, renderGithubComment } from 'repo-aeo'`.
- Safety: audit-only by default; `fix`/`init` need `--apply`; `github-sync` needs `--apply --ack <ACK> --reason "<why>"`; publish/tag/release are never performed.
